audit.why: Lane framing holds: Brand out-pokes early (W 900 range into Q stun on ablaze targets), TF takes over at 6 off Brand's total immobility. 53.06% WR, TRICKY 7/10 fits.

audit.why: ownerKit R cd; packet levelChart matches content.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere (packet defect: zero sequencing cues). Sear is 8s at rank 1, Pyroclasm 100/90/80, Conflagration 13s rank 1 — the numbers that make 'wait for Sear' concrete.
audit.corrected: Added to breakdown.cooldowns. Also: Sear, Pillar and Pyroclasm are all projectiles; TF's Q likewise — no other unstated interaction found.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet suspectName 'Gold Card' in spikes[1].text is a false positive — Gold Card is Pick a Card's real stun card.

edits.before: W online: the gold card re-prices his every step-up. Lock yellow when he walks forward and the lane behaves.
edits.after: W online: Blue Card mana and Wild Cards match his clear, and you shove him off his 900-range last-hit pattern.

edits.before: Full kit: stacked-deck autos plus card cycling is a real short trade — but your game is the clock, not the lane.
edits.after: Full kit: an even shove-and-poke standoff — his Sear stun against your locked yellow, decided by spacing.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q the wave, lock cards on cooldown, and watch side lanes like they're your KDA.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing for both — waveclear stays even, nobody has spiked; Q the wave and bank for level 6.

edits.before: Destiny online — THE level in this lane. Every shove is now a bot-lane death sentence with a 130-second timer.
edits.after: Destiny online — THE level: Brand has no dash at all, so Gate flanks and Gold Card all-ins are nearly free.

edits.before: Lich Bane spike: gold card chunks half bars. The lane still isn't the point — the map pays your salary.
edits.after: Lich Bane spike: gold card chunks half bars, and your roam tempo beats a Brand glued to mid with no escape.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W gold card for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — 8s at rank 1, and it only stuns while you are ablaze: after eating W or E, dodge the Q line for 4 seconds. - Conflagration is 13s early — his poke slows without it. - Pyroclasm (100s) is the don't-group timer.

edits.before: Lock gold off-screen, walk up once, card-auto-Q, and leave — one stun-chunk per cycle is all the lane asks of you.
edits.after: Fan Wild Cards through the wave onto him and card only when he steps up — never walk into 1050 Sear range for an auto.

edits.before: Cycling cards inside his engage range for stacked-deck greed — TF dies in exactly one mistimed auto-walk per game; don't pre-book it.
edits.after: A shove into fog at 6 hands him a free Pyroclasm-Sear collapse with his jungler — check the map before you push past river.

edits.before: Brand wins by landing Sear (Stun), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Brand wins by stacking Blaze with Pillar and Conflagration, then landing the guaranteed Sear stun on the ablaze you.
